actual: Related to BUG-2101: shared bounded repair must supplement missing stk_limit.pre_close from actual same-date Tushare daily.pre_close with unchanged official bounds. The monthly correction reader currently accepts only tushare.stk_limit sources, so legitimate mixed-source repairs cannot reach inherited frozen bins. Accept and verify explicit dual-source proof without fake receipts, historical scans, or runtime DB fallback. Separate BUG because backend-main and worker-scheduler are distinct runtime targets.
